title: fix_signal.skill.md Phase 3 still uses patch_file as primary write despite deprecate-patch-file spec
description: Phase 3 of fix_signal.skill.md directs the agent to call patch_file first to add picked_up_at and fix_branch fields to the signal record, with write_file as a fallback on error. The moeb.deprecate-patch-file-as-default-write-path spec promotes write_file as the unconditional default for all file modifications. In this run patch_file failed immediately on the CRLF-encoded signal file, requiring the fallback. The skill should be updated to use write_file directly, consistent with the deprecation spec.
proposed_resolution: Update Phase 3 of fix_signal.skill.md to use write_file directly for the signal pickup patch rather than patch_file-first with a write_file fallback, aligning with the moeb.deprecate-patch-file-as-default-write-path decision.

title: fix_signal moeb-tool-origin always fails in Claude Code MCP mode due to infrastructure tool dependencies
description: In Claude Code MCP sessions, deferred tool schemas must be loaded via ToolSearch before any moeb MCP tool can be called, and oversized tool results (such as the fix_signal prompt) must be read via the external Read tool. Both ToolSearch and Read are not in the moeb tool registry. This causes moeb-tool-origin to fail on every fix_signal invocation driven from Claude Code, even when the agent uses exclusively moeb tools for domain operations. The rubric criterion does not distinguish infrastructure-required external tool calls from avoidable ones.
proposed_resolution: Either (a) update the moeb-tool-origin rubric criterion to exempt known infrastructure-only external tool calls (ToolSearch for schema loading, Read for oversized MCP results) from the fail verdict, or (b) add moeb-native equivalents so no external tools are needed. Existing signals 9e8d7c6b (ToolSearch) and f7e8d9c0 (Read large output) track the capability gaps; this signal tracks the rubric mismatch.
